claims.claim: Clean and Sharp UK Used Canon EOS D650 DSLR Camera
claims.evidence: Witness report identifies a black Canon DSLR and reads Canon branding; model is stated as EOS 650D. No clear evidence of 'clean' condition beyond general visibility.
Witness report shows lens focal length markings with 18–55 visible.
Witness report notes the camera works/functional status is not shown (no shutter count, autofocus performance, sensor condition, or test results).

risks.risk: Unconfirmed shutter count / overall shutter wear and whether the camera actually functions correctly
risks.proof: A short video showing a full test: power on, menu navigation, autofocus lock on a target, and a burst of photos saved to the memory card (with timestamps).
risks.if_unproven: Price as a used camera with unknown condition/functionality (worst case: may need service).

risks.risk: Lens glass condition (scratches, haze, fungus) and whether focus is smooth
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the lens front and rear elements under bright light (including edges), plus a focus test video showing sharpness at near and far distances.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a lens of unknown optical condition (worst case: haze/fungus or poor focus).

risks.risk: Sensor condition (dust, scratches, dead pixels) and image quality issues
risks.proof: A sample image of a blank wall at f/16 (or similar) showing dust spots, plus a quick screen capture of the sensor cleaning/inspection if available.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a camera with potentially dirty/affected sensor (worst case: visible dust requiring cleaning).

risks.risk: LCD screen health (dead pixels, dimness) and viewfinder/controls reliability
risks.proof: A clear photo of the LCD showing a bright menu screen and playback, plus a short clip of changing settings and reviewing images.
risks.if_unproven: Price as LCD condition unknown (worst case: partially faulty display).

risks.risk: Missing accessories or incomplete kit (battery/charger/memory card/caps/strap/box)
risks.proof: A laid-out photo of everything included, with each item visible (battery model, charger, lens caps, strap, memory card, and any box/receipt).
risks.if_unproven: Price as body+lens only (worst case: missing charger/battery/caps).

risks.risk: Exact lens variant (e.g., whether it’s IS or non-IS) affecting value
risks.proof: A photo of the lens label/side text showing the exact model (e.g., 'IS' marking) and full focal length/variant details.
risks.if_unproven: Price as the least valuable likely variant (worst case: non-IS).

proof_requests: Show a working test video: power on, menu navigation, autofocus lock, and saving a few photos to the memory card.
Provide close-up photos of lens front and rear elements under bright light (check for fungus/haze/scratches).
Send a sample photo of a plain surface at a small aperture to reveal sensor dust.
Show the LCD clearly displaying menus and playback (no dead pixels/dimming).
List and photograph all included accessories (battery, charger, memory card, lens caps, strap, box).
Photo of the lens label/side text to confirm whether the 18–55 is the IS version.
response.reason: The witness report reliably identifies the item as a Canon EOS 650D DSLR with an 18–55 lens, so it can be priced at its worst-case used condition. The seller’s 'working perfectly' and 'clean' claims are not verifiable from the provided remote evidence, so pricing should assume unknown functionality and potential defects.
